description: PEMS-BAY Traffic Flow Dataset for Time-Series Forecasting is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors 蒙召 张. PEMS-BAY数据集由湾区公路系统各传感器收集的交通流量数据组成。这些数据用于时间序列预测任务，目标是基于历史传感器数据预测未来的交通模式。该数据集包含数月的交通流量读数，常用于评估时间序列预测模型. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 29336214 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
